messages:
Eli (infra): Heads-up: scheduling a rolling soft-reboot for the 'sentinel' rack in us-west2 this Wed 23:00-01:00 UTC. Purpose: NIC microcode + minor BIOS thermal calibration to fix intermittent tx retries. No PSU cycles.
Rae (sre): Copy. What's expected capacity hit?
Eli (infra): Expect ~7-11% reduction during peak. Plan: drain -> soft-reboot -> health-check -> uncordon. Parallelism=2, cadence ~1 node / 90s.
Jordan (oncall): Can we pre-seed warm spares to limit cold KV miss? Need 5 warm GPUs in-region.
Kai (scheduler): Reserving 5 warm GPUs (sentinel-warm). Seeding will run 75m before window: `ops/seed_cache --pool=sentinel-warm --prefixes=hot100 --concurrency=3`.
Bea (support): Draft customer blurb: "Planned maintenance in us-west2 may cause short latency spikes and minor capacity throttling 23:00-01:00 UTC. No data loss expected. Contact support if you have pinned reservations." Posting to #customer-success-drafts.
Rae (sre): Canary: 1 node, 4% traffic for 10m. Health gates: p95 < baseline+35ms, error-rate <0.6%. If canary fails, stop and rollback NIC image.
Eli (infra): Routing hint: avoid nodes with uptime <5m (`route_avoid_recent_boot=true`). We'll also temporarily deprioritize latency-sensitive tenants to other regions.
Jordan (oncall): Paging: if free GPUs <4 for >5m page oncall. Also alert on KV miss >8% for 2 consecutive 1m windows.
Rae (sre): Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sentinel-softcycle. Steps: pause rollout -> rollback_firmware -> rehydrate caches. If p95 regresses >30ms capture tcpdump.
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: "sentinel maintenance in 24h" posted to #eng-infra and #oncall.
Bea (support): Notifying dedicated tenants and legal/product review in progress for public notice.
Kai (scheduler): Timeline: 21:45 seed, 22:50 smoke, 23:00 canary, 23:12 evaluate, 23:15 roll with parallelism=2, finish ~00:40, cooldown by 01:00.
Eli (infra): Cost estimate ~1.1k USD for warmbackfill + IO. Finance acknowledged. React with :thumbsup: to acknowledge.
Jordan (oncall): :thumbsup: I'll be standby 22:45-01:15.
Rae (sre): :thumbsup: prepping dashboards and gates.
Kai (scheduler): :thumbsup: job queued `sentinel-soft-restart-v1` (dry-run passed).
Eli (infra): Thanks team — will publish final blurb after approvals. Anything else?
Jordan (oncall): Nothing else. :coffee:
